name: Mohsen Moghaddam
title: Gary C. Butler Family Associate Professor
department: H. Milton Stewart School of Industrial and Systems Engineering; George W. Woodruff School of Mechanical Engineering
fitReason: Strong adjacent embodied-learning match for a CS project on intent prediction, shared autonomy or multimodal robot interaction. His lab combines learning with actual robot execution, while its wider agenda includes industrial XR, training and design rather than primarily generalist VLA policies.

physicalEvidence.summary: July 2026 AHEAD uses an attention/graph-based intent classifier to guide a physical UR10e with Robotiq-85 gripper during VR-mediated pick-and-place. A 15-participant study compares four interfaces on the real robot. SAIL’s current equipment page lists UR10e and Quest 3, and its people page identifies first author Seok Joon Kim as a current doctoral student, supporting current-group apparatus rather than inherited Northeastern hardware.

shortVisit.summary: Current SAIL pages provide a general contact form and describe current Georgia Tech master’s/doctoral researchers, but no explicit external-master’s, summer-intern or short-term visitor invitation was verified. A request to visit for a research discussion or demo is not a research appointment.

AHEAD learns high-level object/slot intent. Marker-based object tracking, a state machine and scripted Cartesian primitives execute movement; do not call it an end-to-end VLA, learned low-level controller or fully autonomous manipulation system.
The paper’s 76% result concerns offline intent classification, not robot task success. All four user-study conditions completed their tasks, so completion does not distinguish the methods.

Current Georgia Tech appointment supersedes prior Northeastern employment. Reuse Georgia Tech’s external undergraduate/graduate Student Intern and personal-funding notes; do not apply Northeastern’s majority-external-funding rule to this host.
The generic contact form was only read. Its anti-spam controls were neither solved nor submitted; direct public professional email is available in the primary paper.
